messages:
Kai L: quick heads-up — I ran a small sanity sweep for the new reranker/embedding bring-up across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. comparing p4d (A100), g5 (A10G), and a 64-core cpu vm. dims: 1024 vs 768. batch sizes: 1, 8, 32.
Morgan T: awesome — any clear winners? :eyes: 
Kai L: short summary: for embeddings (1024): p4d ~ 420 qps @ bs=32, g5 ~ 270 qps, cpu ~ 38 qps. for rerank (single-pass scoring 10 candidates): p4d latency ~ 18ms @ bs=8, g5 ~ 28ms, cpu ~ 150ms. numbers are noisy but trend is consistent.
Devin K: can you paste the exact command you ran? want to reproduce.
Kai L: sure — command used: ```
bench-run \
  --model rerank-v2 \
  --dims 1024,768 \
  --bs 1,8,32 \
  --backend p4d,g5,cpu \
  --region us-east-1,eu-west-1 \
  --quant none,4bit \
  --queries 5000
```
Kai L: kernel flags: p4d used fused-attn + triton kernels; g5 fell back to cuBLAS matmul for large dims in our build. cpu used openblas with thread pinning.
Morgan T: interesting that g5 falls back — that might explain lower perf on 1024. did you try lowering seq len or using 768?
Kai L: yes — at 768 dims g5 closes the gap: g5 ~ 320 qps @ bs=32. p4d still best but delta narrows.
Sara N: any quality impact with 4-bit quant? we saw small regressions on other bring-ups.
Kai L: ran the quick eval on a 1k sample: embeddings cosine MRR drop ~0.7% for 4-bit, rerank MRR drop ~2.9% on the tuned prompt set. not huge but noticeable.
Devin K: can you attach the CSV or the short chart? bench-bot, did the CI push the artifacts?
bench-bot: artifacts uploaded -> https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/1767123456/sweep.tar.gz :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
Morgan T: grabbing CSV now. looks like eu-west p4d has slightly higher tail latency than us-east p4d (likely infra/networking + enqueued batches).
Kai L: yeah — raw numbers: us-east p4d p95 ~ 34ms, eu-west p95 ~ 48ms for rerank-bs=8-1024. embedding-only p95 delta is smaller.
Sara N: note for release: if we enable 4-bit quant by default on dedicated, we should gate it per-customer and add eval hooks. 3% rerank MRR is borderline for many customers.
Devin K: kernel action: I'll repro on g5 with the triton build and try enabling fused-attn compile flags. if we can get g5 to use same kernels perf might be within 10%.
Kai L: also saw batch shape effect — continuous batching gives much better GPU utilization at bs>=8. for low-latency single-request rerank (bs=1) cpu still competes on tiny models but not here.
Morgan T: next steps: (1) Devin toggle triton kernels on g5 and re-run in eu-west, (2) Kai expand eval to 10k queries for quality, (3) Sara draft gating + rollout note for 4-bit. anyone want to own infra run for dedicated pools?
Devin K: I'll take the g5 kernel work. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sara N: I'll start the gating doc and add the evaluation checklist.
Kai L: thanks — filing a short follow-up thread with the key CSVs and a condensed table. ping me if you want the raw run script. :thumbsup:
